distributed concurrent policy writers and policy anti-rollback

key_rotation_contract.scope: opt-in local workload and management TLS leaf keys; CA and delegated JWK signing keys excluded
key_rotation_contract.publication: immutable generation pairs; overlap pins; atomic profile/config switches; reload ack and live TLS; retire pins; self-revoke old client serials; grace then unlink old files
limits: trusted single control plane with access to selected leaf keys; not independent workload attestation
no CA root/intermediate or delegated signing authority key rotation, HSM, HA, production deployment

authority_contract.scope: opt-in local software root/intermediate/all registered JWK authority rotation; trusted host and network-isolated custodian
authority_contract.publication: leaf pause/ack; old-root-signed sequential manifest; overlapping service trust; quiescent JWK/CA activation; all-leaf issuer migration; TLS/reload receipts; remove old trust; deny all old JWKs; retire owned old secret files
limits: software encrypted vault and its high-entropy password share a local volume; not HSM or physical air gap
trusted host coordinator controls Docker and can run the custodian; no root vault/socket on online CA or leaf controller

ha_contract.scope: Two CA processes on one Docker host; shared single PostgreSQL; opt-in managed client connection failover
ha_contract.database: Independent transport PKI, server verify-full + per-node mTLS client keys, scoped role, SERIALIZABLE transactions
ha_contract.retry_boundary: Fail over only during connection/TLS establishment on network failure; TLS authentication failures and sent POSTs do not retry
ha_contract.maintenance: Leaf publisher stays paused during controlled CA generation/configuration change; every node proves new issuer/JWK before migration and old JWK denial before retirement
limitations: No database replication/failover or multi-host HA
No zero-downtime authority-key ceremony or maintenance SLA
No HSM, anti-rollback, compromised-root recovery or active CRL/OCSP
No generic automatic retry of ambiguous write outcomes
No general claim of ACME/admin API transaction correctness
No automatic lifecycle rotation of the separate database transport PKI
